an6.72:1.1: “Meditators, a meditator who has six qualities can’t attain strength in composure.
an6.72:1.3: It’s when a meditator is not skilled in entering composure, skilled in remaining in composure, or skilled in emerging from composure. And they don’t practice carefully and persistently, and they don’t do what’s suitable.
an6.72:1.4: A meditator who possesses these six qualities can’t attain strength in composure.
an6.72:2.1: A meditator who has six qualities can attain strength in composure.
an6.72:2.3: It’s when a meditator is skilled in entering composure, skilled in remaining in composure, and skilled in emerging from composure. And they practice carefully and persistently, and do what’s suitable.
an6.72:2.4: A meditator who possesses these six qualities can attain strength in composure.”
